_doc: What an untradable piece really costs when its seller does not take emeralds (EarnCost). Hand-maintained from wynncraft.wiki.gg (the pages under sources).
A family matches a piece by its world source (type and name as the item data gives them, e.g. MERCHANT Tempo Town) or by name (items).
currency: what the seller takes; amount: how many a piece costs (items: per piece, else default); perRun: how many one run earns;
minutesPerRun: one run with travel and waits spread over it (a boss with a cooldown counts its wait in part); how: how the currency is earned;
quest: the quest that opens the seller (a piece is an alternative 'after quest' until it is done, as a quest the item asks for).
Effort minutes = amount / perRun * minutesPerRun (runs rounded up); tiers (Legendary Island) give each tier's token, amount, clears (runs) and the tier it consumes.
The road map charges rules.shopping.effortPercentPerHour (3 %) per hour, at most rules.shopping.effortCapPercent (8 %),
once, for a piece you do not have and an earlier milestone did not pick. Tradable pieces are never charged.

families.how: Time Trouble bosses in Time Valley, each every 8 h
families.note: Fragments per kill are not on the wiki: one per kill assumed. Five bosses, each every 8 h, so 7 fragments take two rounds.
One piece per voucher per class; the Master Voucher comes from the whole quest (Lv 80-101).

families.how: a division of The Qira Hive
families.note: Each division gives one voucher of its element; one voucher buys one piece per class; another costs 10 catalysts.

families.how: Legendary Island clears (12 Emerald Blocks each)
families.note: A clear gives 25 Bronze, 15 Silver, 7 Gold and 1 Diamond token; each tier also takes the tier below (Diamond: 2 Diamond tokens and the Gold piece), so a Diamond piece is two clears. Rings cost half (a Diamond ring is one clear).
Items cost 2-6 of the corrupted boss's token (Peaceful Rest: 6); a run gives one, plus a key to get in.
Admiral: 4 Redbeard's Hair, Blasphemy: 4 Theorick's Permafrost; a run gives one token.
